name: Steins;Gate
tagline: Time travel thriller that changed anime forever
description: A self-proclaimed mad scientist accidentally discovers time travel through a modified microwave, leading to dire consequences. Steins;Gate is widely regarded as one of the best time travel stories ever told, with perfect pacing, mind-bending plot twists, and emotional depth.
pros: Perfect plot with zero plot holes
seoDescription: Dive into Steins;Gate's world of time travel thrills. Discover why it's a must-watch anime!
